// why: `packages/api/tsconfig.json` includes `src` only, so nothing under `test/` is typechecked
by anything (CLAUDE.md says the same about the root `test/`). A compile-time guard that no
compiler runs is not a guard. This project compiles `test/contract/` — type-level assertions
about the staff callback contract, no runtime code — and the root tsconfig references it, so
`pnpm typecheck` builds it on every push. `test/staff-contract.test.ts` invokes the same
build so the suite reports the same failure under a test name.
Deliberately NOT the whole `test/` tree: this project must fail for one reason only.
